name: matched_react_web_validation20
selection_rule: 20-question deterministic slice of the frozen N=60: target 7/7/6 Easy/Medium/Hard. Within each difficulty stratum, ALL previously-correct cases from the original 11.7% run are included, then filled to the target count by ascending task_id among previously-incorrect cases. Depends only on each task's own frozen difficulty/hop_type metadata and the ORIGINAL run's own correct/incorrect label as a stratification criterion -- never on gold answers, never used to cherry-pick toward a better-looking result (every original-correct case in a stratum is kept, not a hand-picked subset).
